name: Satsujin Moon (owner build, 2026-09-27)
_about: The project owner's build and written rotation: Shadow Slash opener; New Moon -> Full Moon -> Million Stab -> Dragon Omamori -> Omamori Jutsu -> Full Moon; auto-attacks with Thousand Arms / Shadow Slash woven in until New Moon is back. Options: slashOpener (Shadow Slash first), backStab off (not in the rotation), seedTalisman off (Dragon Omamori only as the cycle's middle step), weaveMs (swing timer: a swing holds you this long, the next waits the attack interval; unset = a swing holds you the whole interval).
